# Psalm 146 — Disagreement Log

## 146:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** I-will-praise YHWH in-my-life; I-will-sing-praises to-my-God while-I-exist.
- **LOGOS:** I will praise the LORD as long as I live; I will sing praises to my God while I have my being.
- **PNEUMA:** I will praise the LORD my entire life; I will sing praises to my God as long as I breathe.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 146:9 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** YHWH keeps the-sojourners; the-fatherless and-the-widow he-sustains, and-way-of the-wicked he-makes-crooked.
- **LOGOS:** The LORD watches over the sojourners; he upholds the fatherless and the widow, but the way of the wicked he brings to ruin.
- **PNEUMA:** The LORD protects foreigners. He supports orphans and widows. But he twists the plans of the wicked.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **PNEUMA:** When they die, they return to the ground, and on that very day all their plans evaporate.
